card.name: Elevation of the extremities in hypotension care
card.fires_on: The word "of" (or "the" after "of") right after "elevation" in overdose and hypotension treatment lists, just before "the extremities" or "lower extremities". It also fires weakly on a linking word like "which" in reflux text.

modes.label: Elevation of limbs
modes.description: "of" or "the" after "elevation" in supportive care for low blood pressure after overdose.
modes.example: For hypotension, consider intravenous fluids, elevation<< of>> the legs, and an inotropic vas

modes.label: Reflux pressure clause
modes.description: The word "which" after a list of causes of raised abdominal pressure in reflux text.
modes.example: any increase in abdominal pressure (such as obesity),<< which>> can push acid back from the stomach up
